d: Anton Oilfield Services Group is a globally leading independent integrated oilfield technology services company, operating across major oil and gas production regions worldwide. The business covers oilfield technical services, oilfield management services, oil and gas development operations, natural gas utilization, AI-enabled solutions, and platform collaboration. Anton Group employs approximately 7,000 staff from over 30 countries and regions. Anton’s long-term goal is to become a world-leading green energy technical services company, growing together with its clients and talent to promote high-quality development in the energy industry.
q: Diploma in Chemical, Mechanical, Instrumentation, Process Engineering, or Process Control Technology. A relevant Science degree is also acceptable.
Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in Oil & Gas or industrial process plant operations.
Practical experience operating production facilities and process equipment, preferably involving crude treatment, dehydration, desalting, gas processing, and water injection systems.
Knowledge of plant commissioning, shutdown, routine inspections, chemical handling, sampling, and process monitoring.
Understanding of work permit systems, process safety, and HSE requirements.
Ability to interpret operating parameters, maintain production records, and identify abnormal plant conditions.
Good written and spoken English communication skills.
Willingness to work on a rotational shift basis.
r: li
Operate and monitor production facilities and process units on a shift basis, including commissioning and decommissioning activities.
li
Conduct routine plant inspections to ensure safe and efficient operation of process equipment, machinery, pumps, and auxiliary systems.
li
Operate and adjust valves, pumps, machinery, and process equipment in accordance with operating procedures and HSE requirements.
li
Monitor and control crude oil treatment, dehydration, desalting, gas sweetening, gas dehydration, water injection, and other process systems.
li
Monitor chemical consumption and injection rates, maintain optimum chemical dosage, and report abnormal consumption or operating conditions.
li
Perform pre-start-up, shutdown, commissioning, and decommissioning activities and adjust operating parameters to maintain process efficiency.
li
Monitor water levels, flow rates, tank inventories, and other process parameters to ensure continuous facility operation.
li
Collect process samples, coordinate laboratory testing, and communicate results to the relevant operations personnel.
li
Perform routine equipment care, including lubrication, oil replenishment, chemical addition, valve operation, separator draining, and process adjustments.
li
Record and report operational data, including production volumes, gas and water flow rates, crude quality, chemical consumption, and equipment performance.
li
Conduct process safety checks, support work permit activities, and ensure compliance with HSE procedures and emergency response requirements.
li
Inspect fire protection systems, operate fire pumps and standby generators, and report equipment deficiencies.
li
Identify and report abnormal operating conditions and take appropriate emergency action to protect personnel, equipment, and facilities.
li
Maintain cleanliness and housekeeping across assigned plant areas and equipment.
li
Perform shift duties and other operational tasks as assigned.

d: As the Forward Deployed Software Engineer at Arabic.AI, you will be the senior engineer embedded with our enterprise and government clients across the region, integrating and deploying our platforms and solutions inside their environments. Working directly with client technical teams, you will understand their systems, data and integration needs, and turn them into production-grade solutions: backend services, APIs, data pipelines and, where needed, user-facing applications. You will deploy and run these solutions on cloud or on-premise infrastructure using containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD and infrastructure as code, making sure they are secure, reliable and performant. Owning delivery from technical discovery to go-live and handover, you will troubleshoot production issues and support clients through adoption. As the bridge between client teams and our Engineering and Product teams, you will feed integration patterns and field insights back into the product and build reusable connectors and tooling that make every future deployment faster.
Work with client technical teams to understand their systems, data sources and integration needs.
Translate client requirements into technical designs and implementation plans.
Communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs clearly to client and internal stakeholders.
Build and integrate solutions in client production environments, including backend services, APIs and front-end applications where needed.
Build data pipelines and connect our solutions to client data sources and enterprise systems.
Integrate AI/LLM components into client applications in partnership with the Data & AI team.
Deploy solutions on AWS, Azure, GCP or on-premise infrastructure.
Containerize applications and run them on Kubernetes.
Set up CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and monitoring.
Ensure deployed solutions meet client security, performance and reliability requirements.
Own technical delivery end to end, from discovery to go-live and handover.
Troubleshoot production issues and support clients through adoption.
Document architectures, integrations and runbooks for clients and internal teams.
Feed integration patterns, issues and feature requests back to Engineering and Product.
Build reusable connectors, templates and tooling to speed up future deployments.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
7+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering or technical consulting.
Hands-on experience integrating systems and building data pipelines in production environments.
Experience delivering technical solutions directly to clients.
Experience with AI/LLM solutions (RAG, agents, model integration) is a strong plus.
Solid experience with REST APIs, microservices and system integration.
Experience with data pipelines and SQL / NoSQL databases.
Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform).
Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).
Strong communication skills and confidence working with client teams.
Fluent in English; Arabic is a strong plus.
Open to on-site or hybrid work across MENA, with regular travel to client sites.
Certifications in at least one of the following: Cloud: AWS, Azure or GCP at Professional / Architect level, Kubernetes: CKA or CKAD, Data platform certifications.

Scale's Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer, you'll own the AI behaviour of production systems our clients depend on, including the agents, evaluations, and backend integration behind them. You'll lead delivery for your workstream and act as the technical point of contact for clients on how their AI performs on live data.
Own the AI layer of production systems for public sector clients, including agents, model integration, and the backend services they run on
Build production agents from established architectural patterns, with reliable tool calling, guardrails, and observability
Select and adapt established evaluation methods, and design new evaluations for client-specific risks where the use case requires them
Apply context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, model adaptation, or inference optimisation where the use case calls for them
Investigate regressions in the systems you own, lead root-cause analysis, and implement preventative changes
Lead project planning for your workstream and manage client expectations on scope, risk, and delivery
Codify recurring client work into reusable tooling, evaluation components, or guidance that other engineers adopt
Mentor engineers through code review, pairing, and delegated ownership
Backend engineering experience, with a track record of taking AI/ML systems into production and keeping them reliable
Experience owning the AI behaviour of a production system end to end, rather than delivering a component scoped by another team
Experience designing evaluations that tie model behaviour to real-world outcomes, and using them to catch regressions
Experience leading root-cause analysis on a production AI or ML system
Comfort working directly with clients, including explaining model behaviour and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
Experience handling regulated or sensitive data and designing for auditability; sovereign or on-premise deployment experience is valuable

Your primary accountability covers production AI behaviour, its backend integration, and the evaluation required for a specific customer. Senior Full-Stack Engineers own the complete user-facing application and its infrastructure. ML Research Engineers lead novel agent architecture and the benchmark methodology used across accounts. The roles work together on agents and evaluation, with accountability set by the scope of the problem.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Next-gen operations at scale, with pure Python infra-as-code, from bare metal to containers and applications. Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure devops.

We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes, and application clusters for customers across physical and public cloud estate, and we are raising the bar on what's possible with automation by embracing a universal operator pattern and model-driven operations.

To succeed in this role you need to believe in automation as a pure software engineering problem, not a hack-it-till-it-works-for-me problem. You need to be interested in the scientific approach to operations at scale, driven by metrics and code, and you need to be able to learn the entire stack, from bare metal networking and kernel up to serverless and open source applications.

Our cloud operations engineers bring Python software-engineering skills and rigour to the operations domain. We practise devsecops from bare metal to application. We architect and run OpenStack, Kubernetes and software defined storage, and we enable devsecops for applications running on that infrastructure too.

To become a member of this team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in a high pressure operations environment with mission-critical services for global brand name customers.

As a member of the team you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure. We drive upgrades to keep our customers on the latest, best solutions.
q: Degree in Software Engineering or Computer Science
Experience with Linux and familiarity with Linux networking and storage
Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Experience with OpenStack or Kubernetes deployment or operations
Familiarity with public or private cloud management
